_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Longvinter egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Longvinter
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The cozy third-person sandbox of fishing, farming, trading and PvP on a shared island. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: v=; [ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && v=validate; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $v +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; d=Longvinter/Saved/Config/LinuxServer; mkdir -p $d; cp -n .raptor-longvinter/*.ini $d/ 2>/dev/null; cp -f longvinter-settings.ini $d/Game.ini; exec ./Longvinter/Binaries/Linux/LongvinterServer-Linux-Shipping Longvinter -log -Port={{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Longvinter. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 1639880) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. The island and longvinter-settings.ini are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1639880}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# Longvinter deletes the config files it ships with when it stops (Engine.ini
# holds its Epic Online Services keys). If they're gone and no copy was kept,
# have Steam check every file, which brings them back.
[ ! -d Longvinter ] || [ -f Longvinter/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Engine.ini ] || [ -f .raptor-longvinter/Engine.ini ] || VALIDATE=1

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

dir=Longvinter/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
# Keep the shipped config files, which the startup puts back when they're gone.
mkdir -p .raptor-longvinter
for f in "$dir"/*.ini; do
    [ -s "$f" ] && [ "${f##*/}" != Game.ini ] && cp -f "$f" .raptor-longvinter/
done
# The server's settings live in longvinter-settings.ini, which the startup
# copies to Game.ini (Longvinter deletes Game.ini when it stops). The Panel
# sets the name, password, players and admins in it at every start; the rest
# is yours. Servers from the old egg ran the game's server repository in
# longvinter-linux-server/: their island and settings come over once.
settings=longvinter-settings.ini
old=longvinter-linux-server/Longvinter/Saved
if [ -d "$old/SaveGames" ] && [ ! -d Longvinter/Saved/SaveGames ]; then
    cp -a "$old/SaveGames" Longvinter/Saved/
    [ -f "$settings" ] || [ ! -f "$old/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini" ] || cp "$old/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini" "$settings"
    echo "Copied the island from longvinter-linux-server; that folder can be deleted once it's working."
fi
if [ ! -f "$settings" ]; then
    if [ -s "$dir/Game.ini" ]; then
        cp "$dir/Game.ini" "$settings"
    elif [ -s "$dir/Game.ini.backup" ]; then
        cp "$dir/Game.ini.backup" "$settings"
    else
        sed 's/^AdminSteamID=.*/AdminSteamID=/' "$dir/Game.ini.default" > "$settings"
    fi
    echo "Made longvinter-settings.ini."
fi
chmod +x Longvinter/Binaries/Linux/LongvinterServer-Linux-Shipping
echo "Installed Longvinter build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: The message on the signs around the island.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, letters and numbers only, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Tag
variables.description: One tag that helps players find the server in the browser; don't use OFFICIAL.

variables.name: Website
variables.description: A website shown with the message of the day, which players can open in the game.

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: The Epic account IDs of the server's admins, separated by single spaces.

variables.name: PvP
variables.description: true lets players fight and raid each other; false turns that off.

variables.name: Tent decay
variables.description: true lets abandoned tents decay, so the island doesn't fill up with them.

variables.name: Max tents
variables.description: How many tents each player can place before prestige.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
